plan.notes: Source: official UW–Madison Guide, Computer Sciences BS Four-Year Plan (guide.wisc.edu/undergraduate/letters-science/computer-sciences/computer-sciences-bs/). Catalog year: 2026-2027 (live edition; requirements text applies to students whose first term is Summer 2026 or later). Transcription method: the Guide's own official term-by-term Four-Year Plan tables were transcribed verbatim (course placement, credits, semester totals). Student-choice/advanced-requirement slots in the Guide's plan (Linear Algebra, Probability or Statistics, COMP SCI Theory, Software & Hardware, Applications, COMP SCI Electives, all GenEd/breadth and Elective rows) are represented as choice:true with the Guide's own example/recommended courses shown where one is named, and a real 3-credit course from the corresponding requirement list otherwise; alternatives are documented in each slot's choice_note. The Guide prints semester totals of 16/15/15 for Years 3-4 assuming 3-credit advanced courses; note the Guide's own recommended Theory option (COMP SCI 577, 4 cr) would raise Third Year Fall to 17 credits — the 3-credit COMP SCI 520 is shown to match the printed totals exactly. Prereq chains were intentionally left empty rather than inferred (no course-level requisites published in the plan tables). A separate earlier attempt (~/workspace/degree-wave2-work/d2-uwmad/BLOCKED.md) claimed this page has no Four-Year Plan; the current live edition (fetched 2026-09-30) demonstrably includes one (Four-Year Plan section, Total Credits 120), so that BLOCKED conclusion is superseded.
